notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.
